chunks: What comes to you of good is verily from God; and what comes to you of ill is from your own self (your actions). We have sent you as apostle to all mankind; and God is sufficient as witness.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between good and evil in terms of their divine and human sources according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for understanding the balance between divine grace and human agency, particularly in distinguishing between major sins (attributed to God's will) and minor faults (attributed to human choice). It reinforces the Prophet Muhammad's universal mission while affirming God's omniscience as the ultimate witness to his prophethood, a concept central to the doctrine of Ismah (infallibility) regarding the Prophet's protection from major errors.
